elements.title: Product lifecycle stages
elements.content: A circular lifecycle diagram titled 'We sell millions of products. So making even small adjustments can have a meaningful impact.' showing five connected stages in a clockwise loop: 1. DESIGN AND SOURCE: Maximize the use of recycled content and responsibly source primary materials. 2. MAKE: Uphold high standards of labor and human rights, health and safety, and minimizing our environmental impact. 3. PACKAGE AND SHIP: Remove plastic from our packaging and minimize emissions from transportation. 4. USE: Minimize emissions from product use, enhance product longevity, and seek to avoid exposure to harmful chemicals. 5. RECOVER: Reuse products through Apple Trade In and maximize material recovery at end of life.
